<!--{"pinCode":false,"dname":"9e84a103-1648-48e9-914a-0cfd46f36d88","codeMode":"markdown"}-->
```md
Using [Inputs.range](https://github.com/observablehq/inputs/blob/main/README.md#range) and [Plot](/@observablehq/plot).
```

<!--{"pinCode":false,"dname":"88dc8774-ccc5-45b0-80a6-708d82788025","codeMode":"js"}-->
```js
data = (FileAttachment("penguins.csv").csv({typed: true}))
```

<!--{"pinCode":false,"dname":"68c90639-479f-4a52-ba1c-58c99920ca45","codeMode":"js"}-->
```js
viewof bins = (Inputs.range([3, 20], {step: 1, label: "Bins"}))
```

<!--{"pinCode":false,"dname":"72a22c5d-bd3d-41fc-bac3-a6b23fa57d3a","codeMode":"js"}-->
```js
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0]),
    Plot.rectY(data, Plot.binX({y: "sum"}, {x: "flipper_length_mm", thresholds: 200}))
  ]
})
```
